[[Ashlyn's Shortbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Ashlyn Spiderfriend]], a [[boss]] in [[Magus Stones]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Shortbow (weapon)|Shortbow]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[shortbow]]s:
**[[Shortbow (weapon)|Shortbow]] from collectors [[Attendant Nashu]] or [[Healer Silja]] or crafters [[Honglei Sun]] or [[Manzo]]
**[[Composite Shortbow]] from collectors [[Chinwe]] or [[Kaplack]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*[[Composite Shortbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
